global: This is spicy ramen with a rich, deep-red broth, topped with a generous mound of bean sprouts. It sits in a white bowl with red trim, against a dark background, under warm lighting that highlights the broth’s glossy sheen.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, flat surface with subtle texture and faint golden patterned edge visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red concentric stripes and red Chinese characters on rim, showing slight residue stains.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is deep reddish-brown, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and bean sprouts.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with a smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, rounded tip.
